prompt:
TITLE:
Sudden Wind Street Snapshot

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Japanese gravure-inspired street fashion photography.
Natural daylight.
Casual Instagram-style lifestyle photo.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin, hair, and fabric texture.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Long dark brown hair with soft see-through bangs.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

BODY:
Pronounced feminine hourglass figure.
Natural feminine curves.
Slim waist.
Rounded hips.
Long slender legs.
Realistic adult anatomy and proportions.

OUTFIT:
Fitted white long-sleeve ribbed top.
Very short low-rise plaid pleated mini skirt in muted gray and brown tones.
Lightweight fabric with natural movement.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Busy Japanese shopping street during daytime.
Pedestrians and storefronts softly blurred in the background.
Natural candid street atmosphere.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
She is walking away from the camera when a sudden strong gust of wind catches her.
The wind dramatically blows the pleated skirt upward and outward.
At the same moment, her long hair is swept strongly sideways by the wind.
Surprised by the gust, she naturally twists her upper body and looks back over her shoulder toward the camera.
One hand instinctively reaches toward her skirt.
Playful, surprised expression.
Natural walking motion.
Spontaneous split-second moment rather than a posed photograph.

CAMERA:
Vertical 3:4 image.
Rear three-quarter view.
Camera behind her at approximately waist height.
Frame from the top of her head to mid-thigh.
Her turned face remains clearly visible.
Fast shutter speed freezing the windblown hair and skirt.
Moderately shallow depth of field.

LIGHTING:
Natural daytime light.
Soft realistic shadows.
Natural skin tones.
No studio lighting.

DETAILS:
Strong, consistent wind direction.
Hair and skirt blowing naturally in the same direction.
Realistic pleated fabric physics.
Authentic candid smartphone photograph.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
Adult woman only.
No nudity.
No exposed intimate anatomy.
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
